# Torzon Market

> > Torzon Market is a privacy-focused darknet marketplace enabling anonymous transactions through Tor, PGP encryption, and Monero cryptocurrency with multi-signature escrow protection.

Torzon Market operates as a secure darknet marketplace prioritizing user anonymity and transaction safety through advanced cryptographic protocols and decentralized infrastructure. The platform combines Tor network access, PGP-based messaging, Monero payments, and multi-signature escrow to facilitate private peer-to-peer commerce.
